title: Phoenix by Route 66
subtitle: San Jose to Phoenix the scenic way, by Tesla
note: Two days, one way. Instead of the faster I-5 and I-10 route through Los Angeles, this one follows I-40 to Kingman, old Route 66 through Oatman, Hackberry and Seligman, then down through Oak Creek Canyon and Sedona. Planned for a Model Y with about 230 miles of range at 80%. Pins are approximate; tap Drive here for turn-by-turn.

stops.name: San Jose
stops.note: Leave around 9 AM with a full charge.

stops.name: Kettleman City Supercharger
stops.note: Big site off I-5, but it gets long lines on holiday weekends.

stops.name: Tehachapi Supercharger
stops.note: Top up before the high desert. CA-58 climbs over Tehachapi Pass.

stops.name: Barstow Supercharger
stops.note: Charge well here: the next 145 miles on I-40 are empty desert.

stops.name: Route 66 Mother Road Museum
stops.q: Route 66 Mother Road Museum, Barstow, CA
stops.note: In the old Harvey House depot, a few minutes from the charger. Check the hours before you go.

stops.name: Needles Supercharger
stops.note: Last California stop before the Colorado River.

stops.name: Kingman
stops.note: Arizona's Route 66 hub. Charge at the Kingman Supercharger tonight so you leave near 100%.

stops.name: Cool Springs Station
stops.q: Cool Springs Station, Golden Valley, AZ
stops.note: Restored 1920s stone gas station at the foot of the Black Mountains.

stops.name: Sitgreaves Pass
stops.note: The steepest, tightest stretch of Route 66 in Arizona. Hairpins, no guardrails, big views. Daylight only.

stops.name: Oatman
stops.note: Old gold-mining town where wild burros wander the main street. Skip this loop to save about 2 hours.

stops.name: Kingman Supercharger
stops.note: Top up on the way back through Kingman before heading east.

stops.name: Hackberry General Store
stops.note: Old gas station packed with Route 66 signs, pumps and a red Corvette. Quick photo stop.

stops.name: Seligman
stops.note: The town that started the Route 66 revival. Snow Cap Drive-In and Angel & Vilma's gift shop. No Supercharger here.

stops.name: Williams Supercharger
stops.note: Charge here, then walk Williams' Route 66 main street: Pete's Gas Station Museum is a block away.

stops.name: Oak Creek Canyon
stops.q: Slide Rock State Park, Sedona, AZ
stops.note: AZ-89A drops from Flagstaff through a red-rock canyon. Pull off at the Oak Creek Vista and Slide Rock.

stops.name: Airport Mesa
stops.note: The classic Sedona sunset view over the red rocks. Parking is small; arrive early.

stops.name: Sedona Supercharger
stops.note: Charge while you grab dinner. The last 115 miles to Phoenix are mostly downhill.

days.title: San Jose to Kingman
days.time: about 9 h driving + 1.5 to 2 h charging
days.note: Mostly a driving day: CA-152 to I-5, CA-58 over Tehachapi Pass, then I-40 across the Mojave.

days.title: Route 66, Sedona and Phoenix
days.note: Leave Kingman by 7 AM. Loop out to Oatman and back on the old road, then east on Route 66 to Williams, down Oak Creek Canyon to Sedona for sunset, and on to Phoenix in the evening.
days.warn: The Oatman loop is narrow and winding; drive it only in daylight. If you skip it, the day is about 2 hours shorter.
